verdict.rationale: The official quickstart walks a developer through indexing sample data and building a working search interface (searching, filtering and paginating a sample catalog). The CLI can even create an account during sign-in. Community users independently describe a smooth onboarding, easy setup, being 'very impressed with the developer experience,' and a 'include a JS file and an input and it just works' experience. Missing for 10: an explicit time-to-first-search figure or hands-on timing that substantiates 'within minutes', and step-level evidence of the index-creation and record-upload steps within the quickstart.
